description: Sentiment and impact for one asset (a stock, a coin, gold, silver, crude oil or a currency pair) over 24h, 7d and 30d: story count, high-impact count, impact-weighted and plain mean sentiment (-1..1, the tone of the coverage), tone shares, a timeline, sources and the top stories. A window with too few scored stories says so instead of giving a score. Unknown symbols return 404 with suggestions. (Needs an API key or wallet token: X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer.)

symbol.description: One ticker or asset name, e.g. AAPL, BTC, XAU, OIL, USDTRY or gold

name: muhabbit_asset_sentiment
title: Asset sentiment
